evals.name: linear-restraint
evals.rationale: Near-black canvas, white as the only action colour, weight-driven hierarchy, rings instead of shadows — the canonical restraint case.

assertions.text: All four renders exist (taste.md, tokens.css, tokens.resolved.json, agent-rules.md)
At least one taste principle is a restraint with a guardrail
Every taste principle has chose != over and cited patterns
No banned slop words in authored prose
agent-rules.md lists hard constraints before principles

evals.name: stripe-craft
evals.rationale: Craft-heavy: tinted neutrals, multi-layer shadows, generous spacing — tests whether craft trade-offs survive without being called 'polished'.

assertions.text: At least one craft or system principle mentions tint or layering with a hex/px value
Colour tokens include at least one tinted neutral (not pure grey)

evals.name: incremental-freeze
evals.rationale: Rerun taste only; evidence and measurements must survive untouched and tokens may not drift silently.

assertions.text: evidence block is byte-identical before and after

evals.name: guardrail-catches-violation
evals.rationale: The executable exit must actually fire: a coloured Tailwind CTA and a drop shadow must fail.

assertions.text: Violation names the file, line and rule
